verdict.rationale: openhands-docs-7 directly describes the workflow: watching for new bugs/incidents, gathering logs and changes, suggesting severity, and routing the issue to the right owner, matching the story closely, with additional support from webhook/label-triggered automations (openhands-docs-18, openhands-gh-4). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the triage feature in practice and detail on how 'right owner' routing logic is configured.
